releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.34 - Watchdog Architecture Parity & Sub-50ms Escape Interception
releaseNotes:
* Active Escape Recovery: Intercepts Chrome, Play Store, and Share Sheet escapes in <50ms and dispatches GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK to return directly to Pocket FM
* Universal Ad Activity Recognition: Added support for Unity 3D (FullScreenWebViewDisplay), BidMachine (FullScreenActivity), Fyber (InneractiveFullscreenAdActivity), and InMobi
* Dual-Contrast Inverted Glyph Perception: Detects dark circular badges with white ✕ (Unity ads) alongside classic dark-on-light badges
* Calibrated Bezel Close Coordinates: Probes exact close hitboxes at y=108px (4.5% H) at 988,108 and 92,108
* Real-World Wall-Clock Ad Timer: Tracks true elapsed ad duration and enforces 30s auto-dismiss
